task.payload: {"metadata":{"description":"Custom Claude provider support for DeepSeek Harness","id":"gh:1334178589","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-claude-provider","slug":"MoFeng2223/dsh-claude-provider","topics":["anthropic","claude","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Custom Claude provider support for DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# DSH Claude Provider"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"DSH Claude Provider adds a dedicated Claude configuration interface to DeepSeek Harness. You can add"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" multiple Claude providers, choose reasoning levels for each model, and automatically fetch model li"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"sts and fill in capacity settings and reasoning presets for common Claude models, without editing co"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"nfiguration files manually."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Compared with the official generic custom provider form, the plugin adds a dedicated Claude entry, a"},{"id":"p5s2","text":" per-model adaptive thinking toggle, and automatic defaults for known Claude models. DeepSeek Harnes"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"s handles the saved reasoning configuration natively."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## What this plugin does"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"1. **Adds a dedicated Claude provider type**"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Open **Settings → Models → Add model provider → Claude provider** to use the dedicated Anthropic Mes"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ings → Models → Add model provider → Claude provider** to use the dedicated Anthropic Messages form."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"2. **Adds a per-model adaptive thinking toggle**"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Adds an Adaptive thinking toggle for each model alongside DSH's existing reasoning-level settings. R"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"easoning levels and their corresponding API parameter values remain customizable."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"For Anthropic-compatible models that support adaptive thinking. When enabled, the model adjusts its "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"thinking based on task complexity and your selected reasoning level. When disabled, it uses the thin"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"king token limit associated with that level."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"On save, the plugin writes each model's reasoning levels and adaptive thinking settings to DeepSeek "},{"id":"p12s2","text":"Harness's native configuration."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"3. **Supports paginated Anthropic model discovery**"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"The plugin fetches model lists through an Anthropic-compatible `GET /v1/models` endpoint, follows th"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"e returned cursors to retrieve subsequent pages, and deduplicates the results."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"4. **Fills known Claude model defaults after discovery**"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"When a discovered model matches a recorded Claude model ID, the plugin automatically fills its conte"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"xt window, maximum output length, and reasoning-mode set. Models entered manually remain fully edita"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"ble and are not overwritten by this lookup."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"5. **Leaves every other provider unchanged**"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Discovery, defaults, and reasoning controls are limited to Provider IDs explicitly created as **Clau"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"de Providers**. DeepSeek Harness's built-in providers and ordinary custom providers keep their origi"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"nal behavior, even when they use `anthropic-messages` or expose a `claude-*` model ID."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"### Published package"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"For the browser interface, install the plugin into the Web profile:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Restart the corresponding DeepSeek Harness process after installation."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"### From source"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Clone, build, and package the repository first:"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Install the generated package into the Web profile:"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Uninstall"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"Uninstalling the plugin does not delete official model settings or stored credentials. Existing Clau"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"de providers remain ordinary custom `anthropic-messages` providers, and their saved reasoning levels"},{"id":"p31s3","text":" and adaptive thinking settings remain effective. The dedicated Claude add/edit interface, paginated"},{"id":"p31s4","text":" model discovery, and automatic defaults are no longer available; the official model discovery featu"},{"id":"p31s5","text":"re remains available."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## DSH 0.1.7 upgrade and configuration migration"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"This version targets DSH 0.1.7-alpha.2."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"### 1. The new DSH version is not installed yet"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"Stop DSH, update DSH and the Claude plugin, then start DSH. On its first launch, the new DSH version"},{"id":"p35s2","text":" attempts to migrate the old `settings.yaml` into the current Profile."},{"id":"p36s1","text":"### 2. The new DSH version is installed but has not been run"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"Migration has not started yet. Update the Claude plugin and any other plugins requiring compatibilit"},{"id":"p37s2","text":"y updates before starting DSH. DSH attempts to migrate the old Settings configuration on its first l"},{"id":"p37s3","text":"tes before starting DSH. DSH attempts to migrate the old Settings configuration on its first launch."},{"id":"p38s1","text":"### 3. The new DSH version has already been run"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"DSH has already attempted automatic Settings migration, and some settings may have migration issues."},{"id":"p40s1","text":"For this plugin, the possible impact is limited to missing Claude provider type markers. **Model con"},{"id":"p40s2","text":"figuration and operation are unaffected by the missing markers.**"},{"id":"p41s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p42s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":false}
